# Add AphiaID to list from worrms (takes a long time)
```{r}
scientific_name_table <- scientific_name_table %>% mutate(AphiaID = NA_integer_)

aphia_cache <- list()

get_aphia_id_with_retry <- function(scientific_name, retries = 3) {
  if (scientific_name %in% names(aphia_cache)) {
    return(aphia_cache[[scientific_name]])
  } else {
    result <- tryCatch({
      aphia_id <- wm_name2id(name = scientific_name)
      aphia_cache[[scientific_name]] <- aphia_id
      return(aphia_id)
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("timeout", e$message) && retries > 0) {
      return(get_aphia_id_with_retry(scientific_name, retries - 1))
      } else {
      aphia_cache[[scientific_name]] <- NA_integer_
      return(NA_integer_)
      }
    })
    return(result)
  }
}

scientific_name_table <- scientific_name_table %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(AphiaID = get_aphia_id_with_retry(Scientific.Name)) %>%
  ungroup()

scientific_name_table_addAphiaBackup <- scientific_name_table
#scientific_name_table <- scientific_name_table_addAphiaBackup #to reset
```

#Ingest and cleanup the WORMS db download
```{r}
WORMS_db <- read_delim(WORMS_db_taxontxt_location, col_types = "c", na = c("","NA"))
WORMS_identifier_db <- read_delim(WORMS_db_identifiertxt_location, col_types = "c", na = c("","NA"))
WORMS_identifier_db_combined <- WORMS_identifier_db %>%
  group_by(taxonID) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ paste(unique(.), collapse = ";")), .groups = 'drop')


WORMS_db <- WORMS_db %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "[\r\n]", "")))
WORMS_identifier_db_combined <- WORMS_identifier_db_combined %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "[\r\n]", "")))

WORMS_db <- left_join(WORMS_db, WORMS_identifier_db_combined, by = "taxonID")

WORMS_db$AphiaID <- gsub("urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:", "", WORMS_db$taxonID)
WORMS_db$Accepted_AphiaID <- gsub("urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:", "", WORMS_db$acceptedNameUsageID)
WORMS_db$parent_AphiaID <- gsub("urn:lsid:marinespecies.org:taxname:", "", WORMS_db$parentNameUsageID)

WORMS_db$speciesNOsubgenus <- ifelse(
  WORMS_db$taxonRank %in% c("Species", "Subspecies"),
  gsub("\\s*\\([^\\)]+\\)", "", WORMS_db$scientificName),  # Remove text within parentheses
  NA  # For rows that are not "Species" or "Subspecies", set as NA
)

WORMS_db <- WORMS_db %>% mutate(AphiaID = as.integer(AphiaID))

WORMS_db <- WORMS_db %>%
 group_by(Accepted_AphiaID) %>%
  mutate(
    unacceptedAphiaID = if (is.na(first(Accepted_AphiaID))) {
      NA_character_
    } else {
      ids <- unique(AphiaID[!is.na(AphiaID) & AphiaID != first(Accepted_AphiaID)])
      if (length(ids) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(ids, collapse = ";")
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

if ("datasetID.x" %in% names(WORMS_db) &&
    all(is.na(WORMS_db$datasetID.x))) {
  WORMS_db <- WORMS_db %>%
    select(-datasetID.x) %>%
    dplyr::rename(datasetID = datasetID.y)
}
```

```{r}
names(pull_NCBI_lu_df)[names(pull_NCBI_lu_df) == "TaxId"] <- "identifier"
pull_NCBI_lu_df <- pull_NCBI_lu_df %>% mutate(AphiaID = as.integer(AphiaID))

new_records_trimCol <- left_join(new_records_trimCol, pull_NCBI_lu_df, by = "AphiaID")

#Add the "NCBI:txid" text to the NCBI columns
specific_NCBI_cols <- c("identifier", "accepted_NCBI", "parent_NCBI")
new_records_trimCol <- new_records_trimCol %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(specific_NCBI_cols), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.), paste0("NCBI:txid", .), .)))

#Add the subgenus, speciesEpithet, and infraspecificEpithet columns
new_records_trimCol <- new_records_trimCol %>%
  mutate(
    parsed_genus = word(scientificName, 1),
    subgenus = str_extract(scientificName, "^\\w+\\s*\\(.*?\\)"),
    
    specificEpithet = case_when(
      is.na(taxonRank) ~ NA_character_,
      taxonRank %in% c("Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class", "Phylum", "Kingdom", "Infraclass", "Infraorder", "Suborder", "Superclass", "Parvorder", "Superfamily", "Subfamily", "Subphylum", "Parvphylum", "Phylum (Division)", "Subclass", "Superorder", "Subgenus", "Tribe") ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(scientificName, "^\\w+\\s*\\(.*?\\)") ~ word(scientificName, 3),
      TRUE ~ word(scientificName, 2)
    ),
    
    infraspecificEpithet = case_when(
      taxonRank %in% c("Subspecies", "Variety", "Forma") ~ str_extract(scientificName, "^\\w+\\s*\\(.*?\\)?\\s+\\w+\\s+\\w+\\s+(.*)"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # Validate that the parsed genus matches the existing genus column
    specificEpithet = if_else(parsed_genus == genus, specificEpithet, NA_character_),
    infraspecificEpithet = if_else(parsed_genus == genus, infraspecificEpithet, NA_character_),
    subgenus = if_else(parsed_genus == genus, subgenus, NA_character_)
  ) %>%
dplyr::select(-parsed_genus)  # Remove parsed_genus column after validation

#Check if there are any genera that are not being parsed correctly
mismatch_df <- new_records_trimCol %>%
  filter(genus != word(scientificName, 1))

new_records_trimCol <- new_records_trimCol %>% distinct()
```

```{r}
create_chunks_with_controls <- function(names, chunk_size, pos_names) {
  chunks <- list()
  first_control <- pos_names[1]
  end_controls <- pos_names[-1]
  
  for (i in seq(1, length(names), by = chunk_size)) {
    chunk_names <- names[i:min(i + chunk_size - 1, length(names))]

    full_list <- c(first_control, chunk_names, end_controls)
    chunk_string <- paste0("(", paste(full_list, collapse = "[Organism]) OR ("), "[Organism])")
    
    chunks[[length(chunks) + 1]] <- chunk_string
  }
  return(chunks)
}
```

#Check for positive control results in each chunk
```{r}
chunk_files <- list.files("NCBI_search/names", pattern = "^NCBI_taxonomy_0[1247]_.*chunk.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

validate_chunk <- function(chunk_file, positive_control) {
  chunk_df <- read_delim(chunk_file, delim = "\t", col_names = c(
    "TaxId", "AkaTaxId", "Status", "Rank", "Scientific.Name", 
    "Genus", "Species", "ModificationDate"
  ), show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  chunk_df <- chunk_df %>%
  mutate(Scientific.Name = str_to_upper(Scientific.Name))
  
  specific_NCBI_cols <- c("TaxId")
  chunk_df <- chunk_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(specific_NCBI_cols), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.), paste0("NCBI:txid", .), .)))

  match_df <- chunk_df %>%
    filter(Scientific.Name %in% positive_control$Scientific.Name)

  merged <- match_df %>%
    inner_join(positive_control, by = "Scientific.Name")

  mismatches <- merged %>% filter(TaxId != as.character(NCBI_taxID))
  missing_controls <- setdiff(positive_control$Scientific.Name, merged$Scientific.Name)
  
  if (nrow(mismatches) == 0 && length(missing_controls) == 0) {
    cat("NCBI search function successful for", chunk_file, "\n")
  }
  if (length(missing_controls) > 0) {
    cat("ERROR: NCBI search function failed, missing controls in", chunk_file, "\n")
  }
  if (nrow(mismatches) > 0) {
    cat("ERROR: Mismatches in positive controls from expected in", chunk_file, ":\n")
    print(mismatches)
    cat("\n")
  }
}

invisible(lapply(chunk_files, validate_chunk, positive_control = positive_control))
```

```{r}
extract_binomials <- function(x) {

  x <- str_to_upper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "-"]

  components <- str_split(x, "\\s+[X×]\\s+")

  unlist(lapply(components, function(parts) {
    str_extract(
      trimws(parts),
      "^[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]'-]*\\s+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]'-]*"
    )
  })) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    trimws() %>%
    unique()
}

has_non_control_results <- function(results_df) {

  positive_binomials <- extract_binomials(
    positive_control$Scientific.Name
  )

  returned_names <- str_to_upper(
    trimws(as.character(results_df$Scientific.Name))
  )

  returned_names <- unique(
    returned_names[!is.na(returned_names) &
                     returned_names != "" &
                     returned_names != "-"]
  )

  if (length(returned_names) == 0) {
    return(FALSE)
  }

  # Split each name into its hybrid components
  components <- str_split(returned_names, "\\s+[X×]\\s+")

  # A name is control-related if ANY component matches a control binomial
  is_control_related <- vapply(components, function(parts) {

    binomials <- str_extract(
      trimws(parts),
      "^[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]'-]*\\s+[[:alpha:]][[:alpha:]'-]*"
    )

    any(binomials %in% positive_binomials, na.rm = TRUE)

  }, logical(1))

  any(!is_control_related)
}

if (has_non_control_results(File01_taxonomy_names_search)) {
```

```{r}
            by = c("acceptedNameUsage_uc" = "Scientific.Name")) %>%
  mutate(accepted_NCBI = ifelse(!is.na(NCBITaxId), NCBITaxId, accepted_NCBI)) %>%
  select(-NCBITaxId)

File02_updated <- matches_scientific %>%
  select(-accepted_NCBI) %>%
  left_join(
    matches_accepted %>% select("Scientific.Name", "accepted_NCBI"), 
    by = "Scientific.Name"
  )

File02_updated <- File02_updated %>%
  mutate(
    identifier = ifelse(!is.na(identifier), paste0("NCBI:txid", identifier), NA),
    accepted_NCBI = ifelse(!is.na(accepted_NCBI), paste0("NCBI:txid", accepted_NCBI), NA)
  )
File02_updated_wResults <- File02_updated %>%
  filter(!is.na(identifier) | !is.na(accepted_NCBI))

File02_updated_wResults <- File02_updated_wResults %>%
  dplyr::select(-acceptedNameUsage_uc)

UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB <- rows_update(UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB, File02_updated_wResults, by = "Scientific.Name")

} else {
  message("Skipping File02: results contain only positive-control-related names.")
}
```

```{r}
multiple_NCBI_records <- UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      c(identifier, accepted_NCBI, parent_NCBI),
      ~ str_detect(coalesce(as.character(.x), ""), ";")
    )
  )

if (nrow(multiple_NCBI_records) > 0) {
unique_NCBI_taxIDs <- multiple_NCBI_records %>%
  select(identifier, accepted_NCBI, parent_NCBI) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    values_to = "taxID"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(taxID), taxID != "") %>%
  separate_rows(taxID, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    taxID = str_remove(taxID, "^NCBI:txid")
  ) %>%
  filter(taxID != "", !is.na(taxID)) %>%
  distinct(taxID) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(taxID))

rank_cols_all <- c(
  "domain", "phylum", "class", "order",
  "family", "genus", "species"
)

ncbi_taxonomy <- taxonomizr::getTaxonomy(
  ids = unique_NCBI_taxIDs$taxID,
  sqlFile = taxa_outfile_ncbi,
  desiredTaxa = rank_cols_all
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    taxID = as.character(unique_NCBI_taxIDs$taxID),
    .before = 1
  )

rank_cols <- c(
  "phylum", "class", "order",
  "family", "genus", "species"
)

ref_cols <- paste0("ref_", rank_cols)

id_cols <- c("identifier", "accepted_NCBI", "parent_NCBI")

reference_taxonomy <- multiple_NCBI_records %>%
  mutate(
    .record_id = row_number(),
    ref_species = specificEpithet
  ) %>%
  select(
    .record_id,
    all_of(id_cols),
    ref_kingdom = kingdom,
    ref_phylum = phylum,
    ref_class = class,
    ref_order = order,
    ref_family = family,
    ref_genus = genus,
    ref_species
  )

ncbi_candidates <- reference_taxonomy %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(id_cols),
    names_to = "id_field",
    values_to = "candidate"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(candidate), candidate != "") %>%
  separate_rows(candidate, sep = ";") %>%
  mutate(
    taxID = str_remove(str_trim(candidate), "^NCBI:txid")
  ) %>%
  filter(taxID != "") %>%
  distinct(.record_id, id_field, taxID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(-candidate) %>%
  left_join(
    ncbi_taxonomy %>%
      mutate(taxID = as.character(taxID)) %>%
      # Compare the second word of the NCBI binomial
      mutate(species = word(species, 2)),
    by = "taxID"
  )

# Score each candidate against the seven reference ranks
ncbi_candidates <- ncbi_candidates %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    ranks_compared = {
      ref_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(ref_cols)))
      ncbi_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(rank_cols)))

      ref_present <- !is.na(ref_values) & trimws(ref_values) != ""

      # Position of the deepest populated reference rank
      deepest_rank <- if (any(ref_present)) {
        max(which(ref_present))
      } else {
        0L
      }

      # Direct and accepted IDs: compare all populated reference ranks.
      # Parent IDs: compare only ranks above the deepest reference rank.
      eligible <- ref_present

      if (id_field == "parent_NCBI") {
        eligible <- eligible &
          (seq_along(rank_cols) < deepest_rank)
      }

      sum(
        eligible &
          !is.na(ncbi_values) &
          trimws(ncbi_values) != ""
      )
    },

    ranks_matched = {
      ref_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(ref_cols)))
      ncbi_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(rank_cols)))

      ref_present <- !is.na(ref_values) & trimws(ref_values) != ""

      deepest_rank <- if (any(ref_present)) {
        max(which(ref_present))
      } else {
        0L
      }

      eligible <- ref_present

      if (id_field == "parent_NCBI") {
        eligible <- eligible &
          (seq_along(rank_cols) < deepest_rank)
      }

      ncbi_present <- !is.na(ncbi_values) & trimws(ncbi_values) != ""

      sum(
        eligible &
          ncbi_present &
          str_to_lower(trimws(ref_values)) ==
          str_to_lower(trimws(ncbi_values))
      )
    },

    percent_matched = if_else(
      ranks_compared > 0,
      100 * ranks_matched / ranks_compared,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ncbi_candidates <- ncbi_candidates %>%
  filter(!is.na(percent_matched), percent_matched > 60) %>%
  group_by(.record_id, id_field) %>%
  arrange(
    desc(percent_matched),
    desc(ranks_matched),
    taxID,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup()

best_NCBI_hits_wide <- ncbi_candidates %>%
  group_by(.record_id, id_field) %>%
  summarise(
    taxID = paste0(
      "NCBI:txid",
      paste(unique(taxID), collapse = ";NCBI:txid")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = id_field,
    values_from = taxID
  )

multiple_NCBI_records <- multiple_NCBI_records %>%
  mutate(.record_id = row_number()) %>%
  left_join(best_NCBI_hits_wide, by = ".record_id", suffix = c("", "_best")) %>%
  mutate(
    identifier = coalesce(identifier_best, identifier),
    accepted_NCBI = coalesce(accepted_NCBI_best, accepted_NCBI),
    parent_NCBI = coalesce(parent_NCBI_best, parent_NCBI)
  ) %>%
  select(-.record_id, -identifier_best, -accepted_NCBI_best, -parent_NCBI_best)

UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB <- rows_update(UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB, multiple_NCBI_records, by = "Scientific.Name")
} else {
  message("No multi NCBI taxIDs found.")
}
```

```{r}
create_taxid_chunks <- function(taxIDs, chunk_size, positive_controls) {
  taxIDs_clean <- gsub("NCBI:txid", "", taxIDs)
  controls_clean <- gsub("NCBI:txid", "", positive_controls)
  chunks <- list()
  for (i in seq(1, length(taxIDs_clean), by = chunk_size)) {
    chunk_taxIDs <- taxIDs_clean[i:min(i + chunk_size - 1, length(taxIDs_clean))]
    chunk_full <- c(controls_clean[1], chunk_taxIDs, controls_clean[-1])
    chunk_string <- paste0("txid", chunk_full, "[Organism:exp]", collapse = " OR ")
    chunks[[length(chunks) + 1]] <- chunk_string
  }
  return(chunks)
}

chunks_taxid <- create_taxid_chunks(taxids_combined, max_entries, positive_taxids)
```

#Check for positive control results in each chunk: MITO
```{r}
chunk_files <- list.files("NCBI_search/taxIDs", pattern = "^NCBI_output_mito_0[356]_.*chunk.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)


validate_chunk_mito <- function(chunk_file, positive_control) {
  chunk_df <- read_delim(chunk_file, delim = "\t", col_names = c(
    "AccessionVersion", "Title", "CreateDate", "Organism", "TaxId", "MolType", "Genome",
    "Completeness", "Topology", "Slen", "SubType", "SubName", "BioSample"
  ), show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  specific_NCBI_cols <- c("TaxId")
  chunk_df <- chunk_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(specific_NCBI_cols), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.), paste0("NCBI:txid", .), .)))

  match_df <- chunk_df %>%
    filter(TaxId %in% positive_control$NCBI_taxID)

  missing_controls <- setdiff(positive_control$NCBI_taxID, match_df$TaxId)
  
  if (length(missing_controls) == 0) {
    cat("NCBI search function successful for", chunk_file, "\n")
  }
  if (length(missing_controls) > 0) {
    cat("ERROR: NCBI search function failed, missing controls in", chunk_file, ":\n")
    print(missing_controls)
    cat("\n")
  }
}

invisible(lapply(chunk_files, validate_chunk_mito, positive_control = positive_control))
```

#Check for positive control results in each chunk: SRA
```{r}
if(!skip_SRA) {

chunk_files <- list.files("NCBI_search/taxIDs", pattern = "^NCBI_output_sra_0[356]_.*chunk.*\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

validate_chunk_sra <- function(chunk_file, positive_control) {
  chunk_df <- read_csv(chunk_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), na = c("","NA"), col_names = TRUE)
  
  specific_NCBI_cols <- c("TaxID")
  chunk_df <- chunk_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(specific_NCBI_cols), ~ ifelse(!is.na(.), paste0("NCBI:txid", .), .)))

  match_df <- chunk_df %>%
    filter(TaxID %in% positive_control$NCBI_taxID)

  missing_controls <- setdiff(positive_control$NCBI_taxID, match_df$TaxID)
  
  if (length(missing_controls) == 0) {
    cat("NCBI search function successful for", chunk_file, "\n")
  }
  if (length(missing_controls) > 0) {
    cat("ERROR: NCBI search function failed, missing controls in", chunk_file, ":\n")
    print(missing_controls)
    cat("\n")
  }
}

invisible(lapply(chunk_files, validate_chunk_sra, positive_control = positive_control))

}
```

```{r}
# Function to classify mitochondrial confidence
classify_mitochondrial <- function(topology, completeness, title) {
  type <- ifelse(tolower(topology) == "circular", "circular", "linear")
  complete_status <- ifelse(tolower(completeness) == "complete", "complete", 
                            ifelse(grepl(", complete genome", title, ignore.case = TRUE), "claimComplete", "noClaim"))
  verified_status <- ifelse(grepl("^UNVERIFIED", title), "unverified", "verified")
  
  paste(type, complete_status, verified_status, sep = "_")
}
```

```{r}
# Helper function for matching and summarizing
summarize_hits <- function(identifier, accepted_NCBI, subtree_identifier_taxIDs, subtree_accepted_taxIDs, ncbi_data) {
  direct_hits <- ncbi_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(TaxId) & TaxId %in% na.omit(c(identifier, accepted_NCBI)))
  subtree_hits <- ncbi_data %>% 
    filter(!is.na(TaxId) & TaxId %in% na.omit(unlist(c(subtree_identifier_taxIDs, subtree_accepted_taxIDs))))

  summarize_category <- function(df) {
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA)
    count <- nrow(df)
    slen_range <- paste0(min(df$Slen), "-", max(df$Slen))
    accession_list <- paste(unique(df$AccessionVersion), collapse = ";")
    organism_taxid_list <- paste0(df$Organism, " (", df$TaxId, ")")
    organism_combined <- paste(unique(organism_taxid_list), collapse = ";")
    paste(count, slen_range, accession_list, organism_combined, sep = "___")
  }

  categories <- unique(ncbi_data$mitochondrial_category)
  
  result <- sapply(categories, function(cat) {
  direct_summary <- summarize_category(direct_hits %>% filter(mitochondrial_category == cat))
  subtree_summary <- summarize_category(subtree_hits %>% filter(mitochondrial_category == cat))
  c(direct_summary, subtree_summary)
  })
  direct_results <- result[1, ]
  subtree_results <- result[2, ]
  names(direct_results) <- paste0(categories, "_directHits")
  names(subtree_results) <- paste0(categories, "_subTreeHits")
  result <- c(direct_results, subtree_results)
  
  
  expected_length <- 2 * length(categories)
  if (length(result) != expected_length) {
    stop("Mismatch between categories and result length!")
  }
  
  return(result)
}
```

# Assign SRA confidence
```{r}
if(!skip_SRA) {
# Function to classify sra confidence
classify_sra_confidence <- function(strategy, source, selection, bases) {
  strategy <- tolower(strategy)
  source <- tolower(source)
  selection <- tolower(selection)
  
  is_high_potential <- 
    strategy %in% tolower(c("WGS")) &
    source %in% tolower(c("GENOMIC")) &
    selection %in% tolower(c("RANDOM", "other", "RANDOM PCR", "MDA", "Restriction Digest", "size fractionation", "unspecified")) &
    (bases / 1e6) > 50
  
  is_other_potential <- 
    strategy %in% tolower(c("Hi-C", "OTHER", "WGA", "WCS", "WGS")) &
    source %in% tolower(c("GENOMIC", "GENOMIC SINGLE CELL", "OTHER")) &
    selection %in% tolower(c("RANDOM", "other", "RANDOM PCR", "MDA", "Restriction Digest", "size fractionation", "unspecified")) &
    (bases / 1e6) > 10 &
    !is_high_potential
  
  confidence <- ifelse(
    is_high_potential, "high_potential",
    ifelse(is_other_potential, "other_potential", "other")
  )
  
  return(confidence)
}
```

```{r}
if(!skip_SRA) {
summarize_sra_hits <- function(identifier, accepted_NCBI, subtree_identifier_taxIDs, subtree_accepted_taxIDs, sra_data) {
  direct_hits <- sra_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(TaxID) & TaxID %in% na.omit(c(identifier, accepted_NCBI)))
  subtree_hits <- sra_data %>% 
    filter(!is.na(TaxID) & TaxID %in% na.omit(unlist(c(subtree_identifier_taxIDs, subtree_accepted_taxIDs))))
  
  # Helper function to summarize by sra_confidence
  summarize_category <- function(df) {
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA)
    run_list <- paste(unique(df$Run), collapse = ";")
    return(run_list)
  }
  
  categories <- c("high_potential", "other_potential")
  
  result <- sapply(categories, function(cat) {
    direct_summary <- summarize_category(direct_hits %>% filter(sra_confidence == cat))
    subtree_summary <- summarize_category(subtree_hits %>% filter(sra_confidence == cat))
    c(direct_summary, subtree_summary)
  })
  
  direct_results <- result[1, ]
  subtree_results <- result[2, ]
  names(direct_results) <- paste0(categories, "_sra_directHits")
  names(subtree_results) <- paste0(categories, "_sra_subTreeHits")
  result <- c(direct_results, subtree_results)
  
  expected_length <- 2 * length(categories)
  if (length(result) != expected_length) {
    stop("Mismatch between categories and result length!")
  }
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Score each candidate against the six reference ranks
identifier_cols <- paste0("NCBI_identifier_", rank_cols)
accepted_cols   <- paste0("NCBI_accepted_", rank_cols)


# Score identifier and accepted NCBI taxonomy independently
compare_taxonomy <- compare_taxonomy %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # -----------------------------------------
    # NCBI identifier taxonomy
    # -----------------------------------------
    identifier_ranks_compared = {
      ref_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(ref_cols)))
      ncbi_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(identifier_cols)))

      ref_present <- !is.na(ref_values) & trimws(ref_values) != ""
      ncbi_present <- !is.na(ncbi_values) & trimws(ncbi_values) != ""

      sum(ref_present & ncbi_present)
    },

    identifier_ranks_matched = {
      ref_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(ref_cols)))
      ncbi_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(identifier_cols)))

      ref_present <- !is.na(ref_values) & trimws(ref_values) != ""
      ncbi_present <- !is.na(ncbi_values) & trimws(ncbi_values) != ""

      sum(
        ref_present &
          ncbi_present &
          str_to_lower(trimws(ref_values)) ==
          str_to_lower(trimws(ncbi_values))
      )
    },

    identifier_percent_matched = if_else(
      identifier_ranks_compared > 0,
      100 * identifier_ranks_matched / identifier_ranks_compared,
      NA_real_
    ),

    # -----------------------------------------
    # NCBI accepted taxonomy
    # -----------------------------------------
    accepted_ranks_compared = {
      ref_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(ref_cols)))
      ncbi_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(accepted_cols)))

      ref_present <- !is.na(ref_values) & trimws(ref_values) != ""
      ncbi_present <- !is.na(ncbi_values) & trimws(ncbi_values) != ""

      sum(ref_present & ncbi_present)
    },

    accepted_ranks_matched = {
      ref_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(ref_cols)))
      ncbi_values <- as.character(c_across(all_of(accepted_cols)))

      ref_present <- !is.na(ref_values) & trimws(ref_values) != ""
      ncbi_present <- !is.na(ncbi_values) & trimws(ncbi_values) != ""

      sum(
        ref_present &
          ncbi_present &
          str_to_lower(trimws(ref_values)) ==
          str_to_lower(trimws(ncbi_values))
      )
    },

    accepted_percent_matched = if_else(
      accepted_ranks_compared > 0,
      100 * accepted_ranks_matched / accepted_ranks_compared,
      NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Identify records with questionable NCBI taxonomy matches
iffy_NCBI_links <- compare_taxonomy %>%
  filter(
    if_any(
      all_of(ref_cols),
      ~ !is.na(.x) & trimws(as.character(.x)) != ""
    ),
    ( !is.na(identifier_percent_matched) &
        identifier_percent_matched < 70
    ) |
    ( !is.na(accepted_percent_matched) &
        accepted_percent_matched < 70
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    iffy_identifier = !is.na(identifier_percent_matched) &
      identifier_percent_matched < 70,
    iffy_accepted = !is.na(accepted_percent_matched) &
      accepted_percent_matched < 70
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    pmin(
      coalesce(identifier_percent_matched, Inf),
      coalesce(accepted_percent_matched, Inf)
    ),
    .record_id
  )

# Pull the full original records, including both match scores
iffy_NCBI_records <- UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB %>%
  mutate(.record_id = row_number()) %>%
  semi_join(
    iffy_NCBI_links %>% distinct(.record_id),
    by = ".record_id"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    iffy_NCBI_links %>%
      select(
        .record_id,
        identifier_ranks_compared,
        identifier_ranks_matched,
        identifier_percent_matched,
        accepted_ranks_compared,
        accepted_ranks_matched,
        accepted_percent_matched,
        iffy_identifier,
        iffy_accepted
      ),
    by = ".record_id"
  ) %>%
  select(-.record_id)

if (nrow(iffy_NCBI_records) > 0) {
  message("Some NCBI/WoRMS taxonomies with <70% matches. Check questionable_NCBI2WoRMS_records_for_inspection.txt to follow up.")
  
  write.table(iffy_NCBI_records, file = "export/questionable_NCBI2WoRMS_records_for_inspection.txt", sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE, na = "NA")
  
}
```

#Local BOLD Searching
```{r}
vector_names <- UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB %>%
  select(Scientific.Name, scientificName, acceptedNameUsage, speciesNOsubgenus) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), toupper)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  na.omit()

writeLines(vector_names, "BOLD_search_patterns.txt")
bold_output_file <- "BOLD_line_matches.tsv"

header <- read_tsv(
  BOLD_local,
  n_max = 0,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair = "minimal"
)

identification_col <- which(
  names(header) == "identification"
)

if (length(identification_col) != 1) {
  stop("Expected exactly one column named 'identification'.")
}

awk_script <- tempfile(fileext = ".awk")

writeLines(c(
  'BEGIN {',
  '  FS = OFS = "\\t"',
  '  while ((getline p < patterns_file) > 0) {',
  '    wanted[p] = 1',
  '  }',
  '  close(patterns_file)',
  '}',
  'NR == 1 { print; next }',
  sprintf(
    '{ value = toupper($%d);',
    identification_col
  ),
  '  gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", value)',
  '  if (value in wanted) print',
  '}'
), awk_script)

# Execute the streaming search
cmd <- paste(
  "LC_ALL=C awk",
  "-v", paste0("patterns_file=", shQuote("BOLD_search_patterns.txt")),
  "-f", shQuote(awk_script),
  shQuote(BOLD_local),
  ">", shQuote(bold_output_file)
)

status <- system(cmd)

if (status != 0) {
  stop("Search failed; check the awk command and input files.")
}

BOLD_select_db_import <- fread(
  "BOLD_line_matches.tsv",
  colClasses = "character",
  na.strings = c("", "NA"),
  data.table = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

#Merge back with information from DB
name_fields <- c(
  "Scientific.Name",
  "scientificName",
  "acceptedNameUsage",
  "speciesNOsubgenus"
)

bold_taxonomy_fields <- c(
  "kingdom", "phylum", "class", "order", "family",
  "subfamily", "tribe", "genus", "species", "subspecies"
)

collapse_values <- function(x, unique_values = FALSE) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)

  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]

  if (length(x) == 0 ||
      all(str_to_lower(x) %in% c("none", "unrecoverable"))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # Remove placeholder entries when valid values are also present
  x <- x[!str_to_lower(x) %in% c("none", "unrecoverable")]

  if (unique_values) {
    x <- x[!duplicated(x)]
  }

  if (length(x) == 0) NA_character_
  else paste(x, collapse = ";")
}

collapse_taxonomy <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_trim(x)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]

  if (length(x) == 0 ||
      all(str_to_lower(x) %in% c("none", "unrecoverable"))) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  x <- x[!str_to_lower(x) %in% c("none", "unrecoverable")]

  if (length(unique(x)) == 1) x[1]
  else paste(x, collapse = ";")
}

normalize_name <- function(x) {
  str_to_upper(str_trim(as.character(x)))
}

#Create name lookup
master_db <- UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB %>%
  mutate(.master_row = row_number())

name_lookup <- master_db %>%
  select(.master_row, all_of(name_fields)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(name_fields),
    names_to = "matched_name_field",
    values_to = "match_name"
  ) %>%
  mutate(match_name = normalize_name(match_name)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(match_name), match_name != "") %>%
  distinct(.master_row, match_name)

#Match BOLD records
bold_db <- BOLD_select_db_import %>%
  mutate(
    .bold_row = row_number(),
    match_name = normalize_name(identification)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(match_name), match_name != "")

bold_matches <- name_lookup %>%
  inner_join(
    bold_db,
    by = "match_name"
  ) %>%
 distinct(.master_row, .bold_row, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Aggregate BOLD information per master record
bold_summary <- bold_matches %>%
  group_by(.master_row) %>%
  summarise(
    # Unique values, preserving first occurrence
    bold_bin_uri = collapse_values(bin_uri, TRUE),
    bold_taxid = collapse_values(taxid, TRUE),
    bold_identification = collapse_values(identification, TRUE),
    bold_geoid = collapse_values(geoid, TRUE),
    bold_country_ocean = collapse_values(`country/ocean`, TRUE),

    # Taxonomy: retain order and duplicates when values differ
    across(
      all_of(bold_taxonomy_fields),
      collapse_taxonomy,
      .names = "bold_{.col}"
    ),

    # Coordinates: retain all entries, including duplicates
    bold_coord = collapse_values(coord),

    # Record ID and nucleotide pairs
    bold_record_nuc = {
  rid <- str_trim(as.character(record_id))
  nuc_val <- str_trim(as.character(nuc))

  valid <- !is.na(rid) & !is.na(nuc_val) &
    rid != "" & nuc_val != "" &
    !(str_to_lower(rid) == "none" &
      str_to_lower(nuc_val) == "none")

  pairs <- paste(rid[valid], nuc_val[valid], sep = "___")

  if (length(pairs) == 0) NA_character_
  else paste(pairs, collapse = ";")
},

    # Unique marker codes
    bold_marker_code = collapse_values(marker_code, TRUE),

    # Count BOLD records per marker, formatted count___marker
    bold_marker_counts = {
  marker_counts <- tibble(
    marker = str_trim(as.character(marker_code))
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      marker = if_else(
        is.na(marker) |
          str_to_lower(marker) %in% c("none", "unrecoverable"),
        NA_character_,
        marker
      ),
      marker_key = coalesce(marker, "NA")
    ) %>%
    count(marker_key, name = "n")

  if (nrow(marker_counts) == 0) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    paste(
      marker_counts$n,
      marker_counts$marker_key,
      sep = "___",
      collapse = ";"
    )
  }
},

    .groups = "drop"
  )

UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB <- master_db %>%
  left_join(bold_summary, by = ".master_row") %>%
  select(-.master_row)
```

```{r}

#TODO: THIS IS NOT WORKING FULLY YET. No non-api key mechanism for pulling remotely.

name_fields <- c(
  "scientificName",
  "acceptedNameUsage",
  "speciesNOsubgenus"
)

records_to_search <- UPDATED_FULL_RECORD_DB %>%
  mutate(.master_row = row_number()) %>%
  filter(is.na(bold_identification))

name_lookup <- records_to_search %>%
  select(.master_row, all_of(name_fields)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(name_fields),
    names_to = "name_field",
    values_to = "query_name"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(query_name), str_trim(query_name) != "") %>%
  mutate(
    query_name = str_trim(query_name),
    query_key = normalize_name(query_name)
  ) %>%
  distinct(.master_row, name_field, query_name, query_key)

query_names <- unique(name_lookup$query_name)

if (length(query_names) > 0) {
  name_batches <- split(
  query_names,
  ceiling(seq_along(query_names) / 100)
)
  bold_tax_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  seq_along(name_batches),
  function(i) {
    message(
      "BOLD taxonomy batch ", i, " / ", length(name_batches)
    )

    result <- tryCatch(
      bold::bold_tax_name(
        name = name_batches[[i]],
        fuzzy = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        warning("Batch ", i, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(result) || nrow(result) == 0) {
      return(tibble())
    }

    as_tibble(result)
  }
)

  write_tsv(bold_tax_results, "BOLD_remote_taxonomy_candidates.tsv")

  #Inspect results
  bold_tax_results %>%
  select(any_of(c(
    "input", "taxid", "taxon", "tax_rank",
    "tax_division", "parentid", "parentname"
  ))) %>%
  arrange(input, taxid)
  
  bold_tax_candidates <- bold_tax_results %>%
  mutate(
    query_key = normalize_name(input),
    taxon_key = normalize_name(taxon)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    name_lookup,
    by = "query_key"
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    .master_row, name_field, query_name,
    taxid, taxon, tax_rank, tax_division
  )
  
  ambiguous_taxa <- bold_tax_candidates %>%
  distinct(query_name, taxid, taxon, tax_rank) %>%
  count(query_name, name = "n_candidates") %>%
  filter(n_candidates > 1)
  
  if (nrow(ambiguous_taxa) > 0) {
    ambiguous_taxa
    message("Check ambiguous_taxa and correct in bold_tax_candidates")
  } else {
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
  }
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
  
} else {

}
```
